items.name: Steven Holland
items.excerpt: Joel's attention to detail is perhaps his biggest asset. Every scribe is beautifully fitted and every drawer closes with a sigh.
items.quote:
When I bought my C18 cottage a lot of work needed to be done, but replacing the kitchen was a priority. Living in Dorset, as I then did, I had no idea who I could trust in the Hebden Bridge area, to do the work. I wouldn't normally consider myself a lucky man but my luck turned when I found Joel's website. I liked the look of his work and I wanted a similar kitchen to the one in his pictures but nothing prepared me for the professionalism and skill of the man.

The renovation of the kitchen wasn't exactly straightforward as I wanted to push the Rayburn back three feet into the chimney-breast which involved lifting the lintel. Most of the time I would be 300 miles away, so asked Joel to project manage all of the work which he readily agreed to do. I couldn't have been happier with the outcome. Joel gave me a complete price for the job which also included replacing the quarry tile with a stone floor. He kept me fully informed throughout, regularly sending me pictures and commentary. I think the finished kitchen looks fantastic and is the most used room in the house. Joel's attention to detail is perhaps his biggest asset. Every scribe is beautifully fitted and every drawer closes with a sigh. For me, the kitchen represents real value for money and looks and feels like it was built by a craftsman. Which of course it was. Joel has subsequently fitted doors and windows to the house and I'm just as happy with them as I am with the kitchen. Not surprisingly the word is getting round and he's now in great demand, but, I know that he's worth waiting for and I wouldn't think of using anyone else as a carpenter or builder. I don't think I could get that lucky again!

items.name: Elaine Robinson
items.excerpt: As well as offering great quality, service and delivering on time, he builds and improves on my ideas. He is my first choice for quality cabinet making.
items.quote: I've used Joel on many occasions over the last few years for kitchens, internal & external doors, staircase and furniture. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend his quality of work to you. I'm thrilled with the kitchen and staircase he has just completed in my new house. As well as offering great quality, service and delivering on time, he builds and improves on my ideas. He is my first choice for quality cabinet making and I have just commissioned wardrobes and a bookcase with Joel because I know he will produce the end result I'm looking for.

items.name: Claire Benedict
items.excerpt: You turned an extremely dirty, dark grimy outhouse into a beautiful kitchen space that I am proud to inhabit. All my friends love it.
items.quote: Dear Joel, I remember when I got in touch with you to have my kitchen done, I have to say I have never looked back. I know how difficult it is to create a thing of beauty in miniature. I have a very small kitchen but you did exactly that; you turned an extremely dirty, dark grimy outhouse into a beautiful kitchen space that I am proud to inhabit. All my friends love it and find the transformation an absolute miracle! All the cupboard dimensions are perfect for such a space, the materials used are of the best. A lot of work went into this, you took great time to make sure everything was to my liking before taking the next step (never second-guessing me), ripping out redundant doors, building up walls, making sure to obtain the exact type of stone to match the existing old stone of the house. I know some builders would not have gone to such lengths, but that's what you get with a pro. Many thanks Joel, and I hope this goes some way in helping! Kindest regards

items.name: Andrew Marsden
items.excerpt: A beautifully crafted and classic kitchen. His attention to detail is incredible and workmanship is of the very highest standard.
items.quote: Joel Dyter drew up plans, supplied and fitted our extensive kitchen and utility room. From the initial meeting Joel was patient with our ever changing requirements, and has created a beautifully crafted and classic kitchen. His attention to detail is incredible and workmanship is of the very highest standard. Joel Dyter Cabinet Maker comes with our very highest recommendation.
